name: Alliance for Workforce Development, Inc. (AJCC)
description: Provides comprehensive employment and training services to job seekers at no cost. Services include a Resource Center with access to computers, fax machines, copiers, and telephones. In addition, we assist with networking opportunities, job search workshops, on-site and virtual interviews with local employers, job leads, and community resource referrals.
address: 1626 Main Street, Suite B, Susanville, CA 96130

name: HOPE Food Pantry
description: Anyone who needs food is welcome! No ID is required. The church will bring you a list of what food is available so that you can select what you want. One of the volunteer “shoppers” will get your food and bring it back to you. The first time you receive food; you will need to complete a short form with basic information about you and your household. You do not need to bring proof of employment or residency with you.

name: Alliance for Workforce Development - Lassen
description: Alliance for Workforce Development provides a single address where partnering agencies, each with their own identity and mission, provide core services focused on meeting the needs of job seekers and employers.
